Friends
918 - The one with the lottery

Teleplay: Sherry Bilsing - Graham & Ellen Plummer
Story: Brian Buckner & Sebastian Jones
Directed by: Gary Halvorson
Transcribed by: Eleonora, Pheeboh, Roni & Vanessa

[Scene: Central Perk - Chandler, Monica, Phoebe, Ross and Rachel are sitting on the sofas. Joey enters]

Joey: Monica, hey, can I borrow the Porsche?
莫妮卡，嘿，我可以借一下保时捷吗？

Monica: Ok.
好的。

Joey: Alright!
好吧！

Monica: But ehm...what is it not?
但是嗯……那不是什么呢？

Joey: (abashed) A place to entertain my lady friends.
（害羞）一个招待女性朋友的地方。

Monica: And what else is it not?
还有什么不是呢？

Joey: (even more abashed) A place to eat spaghetti.
（更羞愧了）吃意大利面的地方。

Monica: Very good!
非常好！ (Gives him the keys) What do you need it for anyway?
（给他钥匙）你到底需要它做什么？

Joey: Oh well, the powerball lottery is upto 300 million and they don't sell tickets here in New York, so...
哦，好吧，强力球彩票高达 3 亿，而且他们在纽约不卖彩票，所以……

Rachel: Oh!
哦！ So you're driving up to Connecticut?
那么你要开车去康涅狄格州吗？

Joey: (hesitates for a moment)Yeah Connecticut...Not West Virginia.
（犹豫了一下）是的，康涅狄格州……不是西弗吉尼亚州。

Monica: Hey, maybe I'll drive you up there!
嘿，也许我会开车送你去那里！ I'd like to buy some tickets myself!
我想自己买一些票！

Joey: Uh!
呃！

Monica: Yeah with Chandler not getting paid, we could really use 300 million dollars.
是的，如果钱德勒没有得到报酬，我们真的可以使用 3 亿美元。

Chandler: Yeah, because if I was at my old job we'd say 300 million?
是的，因为如果我在原来的工作岗位，我们会说 3 亿？ No thank you!
不，谢谢！

Phoebe: Hey will you get me tickets too?
嘿，你也给我买票吗？

Rachel: Yeah me too.
是的，我也是。 oh!
哦！ I have an idea.
我有一个主意。 Why don't we all pitch in 50 bucks, we'll pool our money together and then if we win, we'll split it!
为什么我们不一起出 50 美元，我们把钱集中在一起，如果我们赢了，我们就平分！

Everyone almost simultaneously except Ross: yeah thats a great idea!
是的，这是个好主意！

Ross: No thanks!
不，谢谢！

Phoebe: You don't wanna win the lottery?
你不想中彩票吗？

Ross: (in a mocking voice)Uh...sure I do, and I also wanna be King of my own country and find out what happened to Amelia Earhart.
（用嘲笑的声音）呃……我当然愿意，我也想成为我自己国家的国王，并找出阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特发生了什么事。

Chandler: Still on Amelia Earhart?
还在关注阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特吗？

Ross: The woman just vanished!
女人就这么消失了！

Joey: Seriously, Ross, you don't want in on this?
说真的，罗斯，你不想参与这件事吗？

Ross: No!
不！ Do you know what your odds are of winning the lottery?
你知道你中彩票的几率是多少吗？ I...I mean you have a better chance of being struck by lightning 42 times.
我...我的意思是你被闪电击中 42 次的机会更大。

Chandler: Yes but there's six of us so we'd only have to get struck by lightning 7 times.
是的，但是我们有六个人，所以我们只需要被闪电击中七次就可以了。

Joey: I like those odds!
我喜欢这些赔率！

Ross: Seriously you guys, I can't believe you're going to spend 250 dollars on the lottery, I mean that's such a bunch of boohaki.
居然花二百五十块买彩票，真是胡扯八道。

Chandler: (looking around at the others)I'll ask.
（环顾四周其他人）我会问。 (To Ross) Boohaki?
（对罗斯）布哈基？

Ross: Oh oh, we think Emma is about to start talking so we're trying to be careful about what words we use in front of her.
哦哦，我们认为艾玛要开始说话了，所以我们尽量小心在她面前使用的词语。

Rachel: Yeah so get ready to hear alot of ehm...boohaki, goshdarnit and brotherpucker.
对，所以以后你们会听到很多“胡扯八道”“真见了鬼”和“混球”这种替代脏话的说法。

Monica: How do you know she's gonna start talking?
你怎么知道她会开始说话？

Rachel: Well when I talk to her I almost feel like she understands what I'm saying.
好吧，当我和她说话时，我几乎感觉她明白我在说什么。

Chandler: Kinda like Joey.
有点像乔伊。

Joey: (who wasn't paying attention)What's that now?
（谁没注意）现在是什么？

Opening credits

[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Monica, Chandler, Rachel and Joey are in the kitchen]

Monica: God!
上帝！ Look at all these tickets!
看看这些彩票！ It's so exciting!
太令人兴奋了！ You know I haven't won anything since the sixth grade.
你知道我自从六年级以来就没有赢得过任何东西。

Chandler: Pie eating contest?
吃馅饼比赛？

Monica: Oh!
哦！ You assume because I was heavy that's the only way I could win something?
你认为因为我很重这是我能赢得一些东西的唯一方法吗？

Chandler: No, I saw a picture of you covered in blueberries.
不，我看到一张你身上长满蓝莓的照片。

Monica: (smiling)That was a good day!
（微笑）那真是美好的一天！

(Suddenly Ross comes running into the apartment)

Ross: (yelling to Monica)They're towing your car, they're towing your car!!
（对莫妮卡大喊）他们在拖你的车，他们在拖你的车！！

Monica: I'm parked in a garage on Morton!
我把车停在莫顿的一个车库里！

Ross: (panting)They're towing a car.
（气喘吁吁）他们​​正在拖车。 And I am seeing...spots.
我眼前都冒星星了。

Joey: (sounding panicky)Oh my god Ross!
（听起来惊慌失措）天啊罗斯！ You don't have Emma!
你没有艾玛！ And Rachel you don't have Emma!
瑞秋，你没有艾玛！ (Starts yelling) Where's Emma?
（开始大喊）艾玛在哪儿？ Who has Emma!?
谁有艾玛！？

Rachel: Joey relax!
乔伊放松！ My mother picked her up two hours ago.
两个小时前我妈妈来接她了。 You were there!
你当时就在那里！

Joey: (not yelling anymore)I was?
（不再喊叫）我是？

Racel: Yes and you talked to her...
是的，你和她谈过...

Joey: I did?
我做到了？

Rachel: She dropped off a casserole?
她还送了份烤菜来？

Joey: Oh yeah!
噢耶！ The casserole lady.
噢，送烤菜的那位女士。

Monica: (to Ross)So, did you come by to watch us win the big bucks?
（对罗斯）那么，你是来看我们赢大钱的吗？

Ross: Yeah, uh...
是啊，呃... and then I figured after you win, we could all go out to the balcony and see a night rainbow with gremlins dancing on top of it!
然后我想，在你获胜后，我们都可以到阳台上看到夜间彩虹，上面有小妖精在跳舞！

(phone starts ringing and Chandler comes running out of the bathroom)

Chandler: (hysterical)Don't touch the phone!
（歇斯底里）别碰手机！ I'll get it, I'll get it, I'll get it!!
我来接，我来接！ (picks up the phone)

Ross: (to Monica)Think he washed his hands?
（对莫妮卡）你认为他洗手了吗？

Chandler: (into receiver)Hello?
（对着听筒）喂？ Hey Charlie, what do you know?
嘿查理，你知道什么？

Rachel: (to Monica)What's going on?
（对莫妮卡）发生了什么事？

Monica: Chandler is supposed to find out if he's getting an assistent job at his ad agency.
钱德勒应该查明他是否在他的广告公司找到了一份助理工作。 But out of the 15 interns, they are only hiring three.
但在 15 名实习生中，他们只聘用了 3 名。

Joey: Ooh!
哦！ Tough odds!
胜算艰难！

Ross: (mockingly)Yeah if only it were a sure thing like your 24 state lottery!
（嘲讽地）是啊，要是像 24 州彩票那样确定就好了！

Joey: (smiling)Look who's coming around!
看看，谁终于想通了！

Chandler: (still on the phone)Damnit.
（仍在打电话）该死。 Alright call me when you know more.
好吧，当你了解更多时给我打电话。

Joey: (excited)Did you get it?
（兴奋）你收到了吗？

Chandler: One of the slots got filled.
其中一个位置已被填满。

Joey: (Still excited)By you!?
（仍然兴奋）是你！？

Chandler: Sense the tone!
感受语气！ No that kid Nate got it.
没有，是内特那小子拿到了。

Monica: Oh!
哦！ I hate that guy!
我讨厌那个家伙！ I mean come on kid!
我的意思是，来吧，孩子！ Pull up your pants!
拉起你的裤子！

Chandler: Yeah I know.
是的，我知道。

Rachel: Well, there's two spots left right?
嗯，还剩下两个位置吧？

Chandler: Yeah...I mean I want this so much!
是的...我的意思是我非常想要这个！ I mean, I wanna get one, I want my friend Charlie to get one...Except I don't care about Charlie.
我的意思是，我想要一个，我想要我的朋友查理得到一个......但我不在乎查理。

(Phoebe enters)

Phoebe: (excited)Hey you guys!
（兴奋）嘿你们！ Ok, you're not going to believe this!
好吧，你不会相信这个！ I just saw my psychic and she said I was definitely gonna win the lottery tonight!
我刚刚看到我的灵媒，她说我今晚肯定会中彩票！

Monica: Hey that reminds me, I thought we could use some extra luck so I brought a wishbone home from work.
嘿，这提醒了我，我想我们可以需要一些额外的运气，所以我从工作中带了一根叉骨回家。

Ross: (mockingly)A psychic AND a wishbone?
（嘲笑地）通灵者和叉骨？ Guys!
各位！ Give someone else a chance!
给别人一个机会！

Monica: Alright, who wants to do it?
好吧，谁愿意做呢？

Phoebe: Oh can I?
哦，我可以吗？ Vegetarians never get to do the wishbone.
素食者永远做不到叉骨。 It's really not fair either!
实在是也不公平啊！ You know, just because we don't eat the meat doesn't mean we don't like to play with the carcasses!
你知道，我们不吃肉并不意味着我们不喜欢玩尸体！

Monica: Ok, hey Rach?
好吧，嘿，瑞秋？

Rachel: Oh no, I'm good, I don't wanna get that turkey smell all over my hands.
哦，不，我很好，我不想让火鸡的味道沾满我的手。

Joey: I'll do it!!
我会做的！！ It'll get the casserole stink off of mine.
它可以去除我身上的砂锅臭味。

(Phoebe and Joey both grab one side of the wishbone)

Phoebe: I hope I win!
我希望我能赢！

Monica: Well, it doesn't really matter ...
嗯，其实这并不重要... you're both wishing for the same thing, right?
你们都希望有同样的事情，对吗？

Joey: I can't tell you what I'm wishing for!
我无法告诉你我的愿望！ Else...you know...won't come true!
否则……你知道……不会实现！

Monica: Right!
对！ .. but we "know" what you're wishing for!
但我们“知道”您的愿望！

Joey: Can't really say!
实在说不准！

Monica: I understand, but you're wishing for what we think you're wishing for, aren't you?
我明白，但你所希望的正是我们认为你所希望的，不是吗？

Joey: (slightly irritated)I'm not really comfortable with these questions!
（有点恼火）我对这些问题感到不太舒服！

Rachel, Chandler and Monica: Please, just do it!
拜托，就这么做吧！

Phoebe: One, two, three!
一二三！

(they break the wishbone)

Joey: I won, hey!
我赢了，嘿嘿！

Ross: You know what, I'm sure your wish is gonna come true, but, you guys - just in case, maybe a genie will come out if we rub this lamp!
你知道吗，我确信你的愿望会实现，但是，你们——以防万一，如果我们擦这盏灯，也许会有一个精灵出来！ (rubs lamp, stops because it's very hot) Ah!!
（擦灯，因为太热而停下来）啊！！ That thing gets hot!!
那东西变热了！！

Rachel: You know, Ross, just keep making your jokes.
你知道，罗斯，继续开玩笑吧。 How are you gonna feel if we actually do win?
如果我们真的赢了你会有什么感觉？

Ross: Uh, you're not gonna win.
呃，你不会赢的。

Rachel: Oh, I know, I know, the odds are against us, but somebody has to win, and it could be us!
哦，我知道，我知道，形势对我们不利，但必须有人获胜，而且可能就是我们！ And then how you gonna feel?
然后你会有什么感觉？ You know, we're gonna be all like "oh everybody, let's take our helicopters up to the cape" and you're gonna be all like "oh, I can't guys, I'll meet you guys up there, I gotta gas up the Hyundai"
你知道，我们都会说“哦，大家，让我们把直升机开到海角”，而你们都会说“哦，我不能，伙计们，我会在那里见你们，我得给现代汽车加油”

Ross: Ok, I've heard myself on tape and I sound nothing like that.
好吧，我在录音带上听过自己的声音，但听起来一点也不像。

Chandler: I can see the headline now: "Lottery winners' friend filled with regret eats own arm".
我现在可以看到标题：“彩票中奖者的朋友充满遗憾地吃掉了自己的手臂”。

Ross: Why would I eat my own arm?
为什么我要吃自己的手臂？

Chandler: Well you wouldn't, but we own the paper, we can print whatever we want.
你倒不会真吃，不过报社都是我们的了，爱登什么登什么。

Monica: You know what, Ross?
你知道吗，罗斯？ I'm gonna throw in 50 bucks for you.
我要捐50块钱给你。

Ross: Why?
为什么？

Monica: Because I know that you think the lottery is "boohaki" but we're all here and gonna watch the numbers and have fun.
因为我知道你认为彩票是“boohaki”，但我们都在这里观看数字并享受乐趣。 And you're my brother, and I want you to be a part of this.
你是我的兄弟，我希望你成为其中的一部分。

Ross: You don't have to do that, I'll pay for myself.
你不用这么做，我自己付钱。 But just the fact that you want me to have fun with you guys - that's so sweet!
但事实上，你们希望我和你们一起玩得开心——这真是太好了！ Come here (they kiss and hug)
来这里（他们亲吻和拥抱）

Phoebe: Get a room!
开个房间吧！

Chandler: Ok, so now that you're in, what are you gonna do if we win?
好吧，既然你进来了，如果我们赢了你会做什么？

Ross: I don't know, probably just invest it.
我不知道，可能只是投资而已。

Chandler: Ooh!
哦！ Calm down ...
冷静下来 ...

Joey: Seriously, that's your fantasy?
说真的，这就是你的幻想吗？ To invest it?
来投资它？

Ross: Oh, I'm sorry, did I say "invest it"?
哦，抱歉，我有说“投资”吗？ I meant "be cool and piss it all away" (Joey and Chandler pleased)
我是说，“耍酷，把钱全挥霍掉”。（乔伊和钱德勒满意了）

Joey: Ooh, ooh, I know!
哦哦哦，我知道了！ We should pool all own money and buy the Knicks!
我们应该集中所有自己的钱买尼克斯队！

Rachel: I don't really care about the Knicks.
我其实并不关心尼克斯队。

Joey: Oh, you will when I pick you as starting forward.
哦，当我选择你作为首发时，你就会的。

Rachel: (touched) You would do that?
（感动）你会这么做吗？ I never get picked!
我从来没有被选中过！

Chandler: You know, I'm not sure a sports team is the way to go.
你知道，我不确定组建一支运动队是正确的选择。

Joey: You're not gonna let me buy the Knicks??
你不让我买尼克斯队？？ I can't believe you're taking this away from me!
我不敢相信你要把这个从我身边夺走！

Chandler: You're right, it has been you dream for over 15 seconds.
你是对的，你的梦已经超过 15 秒了。

Ross: (to Rachel) Uh, how long until they announce the numbers, Mommy?
（对瑞秋）呃，他们要等多久才能公布数字，妈妈？

(pause)

Chandler: (looks around) I'll take this one too (to Ross) Uh ...
（环顾四周）我也拿这个（对罗斯）呃...... Mommy?
妈妈？

Ross: Oh, I've gotten into the habit of calling Rachel "Mommy" when we're around Emma.
哦，当我们在艾玛身边时，我已经养成了叫瑞秋“妈妈”的习惯。 Which I now realize we are not ...
不过我现在才发现，她不在这儿……

Rachel: I'm hoping that if she hears it enough it will be her first word.
我希望如果她听得够多的话，这将是她说的第一句话。

Ross: Although if we're gonna do that, we should probably call me "Daddy" too.
不过如果我们要这么做的话，我们或许也应该叫我“爸爸”。

Phoebe: Oooh, I like that, "daddy" (in a sexy tone)
哦，我喜欢这个，“爸爸”（性感的语气）

Ross: I ...
我 ... I was just talking about Rachel.
我刚才正在谈论瑞秋。

Phoebe: (still in sexy tone) Oooh, is daddy getting angry?
（还是性感的语气）哦哦，爸爸生气了吗？ Is daddy gonna spank me?
爸爸会打我吗？

Ross: (tries to be sexy too) Well that depends ...
（也试图变得性感）好吧，这取决于...... have you been a baaad gi ..
你是不是个坏坏的小姑…… (stops) no I can't.
（停顿）不，我不能。

(Phone rings, Chandler picks up)

Chandler: Hello?
你好？ Hello?
你好？ Oh, hey Charlie.
哦，嘿查理。 Did anybody else hear?
还有其他人听到吗？ ... What?
什么？ Susan got it??
苏珊拿到职位了？ How?
如何？ Oh man, I would have slept with him!!
天哪，我会和他一起睡的！ .. Alright, bye.
好吧，再见。 (hangs up)

Joey: Dude, I'm sorry.
伙计，对不起。 But hey, there's one spot left, right?
但是嘿，还剩下一个位置，对吧？

Chandler: Well no, Charlie's gonna get that.
最后那个肯定归查理了。

Monica: Hey, don't say that!
嘿，别这么说！ You got just as good a chance as anybody else of getting that job!
您和其他人一样有机会获得这份工作！

Chandler: He's the boss's son.
他是老板的儿子。

Monica: Come on, lottery!!
来吧，抽奖！！ (everybody cheers)

Rachel: Ooh, you guys, it starts in like 20 minutes.
噢，你们，20分钟后就开始了。

Monica: Ok, here we go.
好的，我们开始吧。 We need to sort out the tickets as quickly as possible to see if we've won.
我们需要尽快把票整理出来，看看我们是否中奖了。 So does anybody have any ideas how to organize this?
那么有人知道如何组织这个吗？ (doesn't let them answer) Ok, how about this: we divide them into 6 groups of 40, and the remaining 10 can be read by whoever finishes their pile first.
（不让他们回答）好吧，这样怎么样：我们把它们分成 6 组，每组 40 个，剩下的 10 个可以由谁先读完一堆。

Rachel: Ooh, I have another idea!
哦，我有另一个想法！

Monica: I'm sorry, idea time is over.
抱歉，创意时间结束了。

Phoebe: Ok, well, are all the tickets in the bowl?
好吧，所有的票都在碗里了吗？

Monica: Yeah.
是的。

Chandler: What about the ones you have on the nightstand?
你床头柜上的那些怎么样？

Monica: There are no tickets on the nightstand!
床头柜上没有彩票！

Chandler: Yes there are, I just saw them a few minutes ago.
是的，有，我几分钟前才看到它们。

(Rachel get suspicious)

Monica: Un, no you didn't!
嗯，不，你没有！ You must be mistaken!
你一定是误会了！

Chandler: Honey, there are like 20 tickets on the nightstand!
亲爱的，床头柜上大约有20张票！

Monica: Chandler, sense the tone!!
钱德，感受一下语气！

(Rachel comes out of their bedroom waving tickets)

Rachel: Well, well, well, look what mommy found!!
好啦好啦，看看妈妈发现了什么！！

(everyone's shocked)

Monica: Ok, fine!!
好吧，好吧！！ I bought 20 extra tickets for me and Chandler.
我为我和钱德勒额外买了 20 张票。

Phoebe: Uh!
呃！ The psychic also said that I would be betrayed.
通灵者还说我会被背叛。

Ross: I can't believe this, I thought we were all in this together!
我简直不敢相信，我以为我们都在一起了！

Monica: Hey, you just got in 5 minutes ago!
嘿，你五分钟前才进来！

Ross: 3 minutes ago!!!
3分钟前！！！ I don't know why that's important ...
我不知道为什么这很重要...

Joey: I was with you the whole time we were in Connecticut, when did you even get those?
我们在康涅狄格州的时候我一直和你在一起，你什么时候得到这些的？

Monica: When you were reading the dirty magazines without taking off the plastic!
当你在没有取下塑料的情况下阅读脏杂志时！

Joey: (to Ross) I'll show you how.
（对罗斯）我会告诉你怎么做。

Rachel: Ok, well Monica, suppose one of your "special" tickets win?
好吧，莫妮卡，假设你的一张“特别”彩票中奖了？ How are you gonna feel when you win the lottery and you lose all your friends?
当你中了彩票却失去了所有朋友时，你会有什么感觉？

Monica: Please ...
请 ... if I win the lottery, you guys are not gonna leave me.
如果我中了彩票，你们就不会离开我。 Someone gave me a basket of mini-muffins last week and I couldn't get rid of you for 3 days!
上周别人送了我一篮迷你松饼，你们赖了三天都赶不走！

（她拿出碗，准备把票扔到街上）。

(All are returning from the street after picking up dropped lottery tickets)
